config.script:
"""
	Populate dropdown with users that have Supervisor_PAPO role.
	
	Args:
		self (View): Reference to the view component
	
	Returns:
		None (writes to self.custom.supervisorOption)
	"""
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger("dautom/views/formPL11-0101/supervisorDropdown")
	
	try:
		# Configuration - camelCase
		targetRole = "Supervisor_PAPO"
		userSource = "default"
		
		logger.info("Starting supervisor dropdown population")
		
		# Get all users from default user source
		allUsers = system.user.getUsers(userSource)
		logger.info("Total users found: " + str(len(allUsers)))
		
		# Filter users with Supervisor_PAPO role
		supervisorList = []
		
		for user in allUsers:
			# Parse username from string representation
			userStr = str(user)
			userName = userStr.split("username=")[1].split(",")[0]
			
			# Parse roles from string representation
			if "roles=" in userStr:
				rolesStr = userStr.split("roles=")[1].split("]")[0]
				userRoles = [role.strip() for role in rolesStr.replace("[", "").split(",")]
			else:
				userRoles = []
			
			logger.info("User: " + userName + " - Roles: " + str(userRoles))
			
			if targetRole in userRoles:
				supervisorList.append(userName)
				logger.info("Added supervisor: " + userName)
		
		# Sort alphabetically for better UX
		supervisorList.sort()
		
		# Write to custom property for dropdown consumption
		self.custom.supervisorOption = supervisorList
		
		logger.info("Supervisor dropdown populated successfully - Total supervisors: " + str(len(supervisorList)) + " - List: " + str(supervisorList))
	
	except Exception as e:
		logger.error("Error populating supervisor dropdown: " + str(e))
		import traceback
		logger.error("Stack trace: " + traceback.format_exc())
		self.custom.supervisorOption = []

customMethods.name: toggleFlexRoot
customMethods.script:
#logging.log("Entered toggleFlexRoot", "info")
	7
	flexGroupCount = self.custom.flexGroupCount          # e.g., 3 groups
	flexCount = self.custom.flexCount                    # e.g., [4, 3, 5]

	# Índices del botón clicado
	thisGroupIndex = int(groupIndex)      # FlexContainerGroupN
	thisSectionIndex = int(sectionIndex)  # SectionN / FlexContainerN
	#logging.log("Group Index that sent the message {}".format(thisGroupIndex), "info")

	# Recorre cada FlexContainerGroupX
	for flexStartIndex in range(1, int(flexGroupCount) + 1):

		# Contenedor del grupo
		flexStart = self.getChild("FlexContainerGroup{}".format(flexStartIndex))

		# Asegurar base inicial por grupo (una sola vez)
		if not flexStart.custom.get("baseBasisPx", None):
			basis_px = int(str(flexStart.position.basis).replace("px", "")) if flexStart.position.basis else 100
			flexStart.custom.baseBasisPx = basis_px

		total_in_group = int(flexCount[flexStartIndex - 1])

		# Flag: este es el grupo activo (el del click)
		is_active_group = (flexStartIndex == thisGroupIndex)

		for secIndex in range(1, total_in_group + 1):

			flex = flexStart.getChild("FlexContainer{}".format(secIndex))
			button = flexStart.getChild("Section{}".format(secIndex))

			if is_active_group and secIndex == thisSectionIndex:
				# --- Toggle del seleccionado (grupo activo) ---
				current_display = bool(flex.position.display)
				new_display = not current_display
				flex.position.display = new_display

				# Ajustar basis del GRUPO ACTIVO según new_display
				group_base_px = int(flexStart.custom.get("baseBasisPx", 0))
				flex_base_px = int(flex.position.basis.replace("px",""))
				if new_display:
					flexStart.position.basis = str(group_base_px + flex_base_px) + "px"
					button.props.style.classes = 'button-questions'
				else:
					flexStart.position.basis = str(group_base_px) + "px"
					button.props.style.classes = 'button-questions-2'

			else:
				# --- Ocultar todos los demás ---
				flex.position.display = False
				button.props.style.classes = 'button-questions-2'

				# Si NO es el grupo activo, su basis debe quedar en base
				if not is_active_group:
					base_px = int(flexStart.custom.get("baseBasisPx", 0))
					flexStart.position.basis = str(base_px) + "px"

	workstationNodeID = self.view.params.workstationnodeID
	workstationID = self.view.params.workstationID
	nodeID = self.view.params.nodeID
	status = "En proceso"
	now = system.date.now()

	flexGroupCount = int(self.custom.flexGroupCount)  # e.g., 3

	# ---- Get next RegisterCode (last + 1 for a new batch) ----
	query_last_code = """
		SELECT TOP 1 RegisterCode
		FROM registerhistory
		WHERE WorkstationNodeID = ? AND PapoID = ?
		ORDER BY ID DESC
	"""
	rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(query_last_code, [workstationNodeID, papoID], "papo_db")
	last_code = rs.getValueAt(0, 0) if rs.getRowCount() > 0 else 0
	regCode = int(last_code) # + 1
	# If you need to REUSE the last RegisterCode instead, set: regCode = int(last_code) or 1

	# ---- Insert template ----
	from java.lang import String
	insert_sql = """
		INSERT INTO registerhistory (
			[Timestamp],
			DataAnswer,
			Status,
			PapoID,
			RegisterTypeID,
			[User],
			WorkstationNodeID,
			NodeID,
			WorkstationID,
			RegisterCode
		)
		VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
	"""

	def _infer_register_type(answers_obj):
		items = answers_obj.get("items", []) if answers_obj else []
		if items and isinstance(items[0], dict) and "registerTypeID" in items[0]:
			return int(items[0]["registerTypeID"])
		return 7

	# ---- Walk every FlexContainerGroupN, collect answers via your function, insert row ----
	for groupIndex in range(1, flexGroupCount + 1):
		flexGroup = self.getChild("FlexContainerGroup{}".format(groupIndex))

		# Use YOUR aggregator to build the answers JSON for this group
		answers_obj = self.answerRecopile(flexGroup)  # {"items":[...]} per your function
		logging.log("Recopiled answers {}".format(answers_obj), "info")
		# Skip if empty
		items = answers_obj.get("items", []) if answers_obj else []
		if not items:
			continue

		registerTypeID = _infer_register_type(answers_obj)
		data_answer_str = String(system.util.jsonEncode(answers_obj))

		params = [
			now,                # [Timestamp]
			data_answer_str,    # DataAnswer (JSON)
			status,             # Status
			papoID,             # PapoID
			registerTypeID,     # RegisterTypeID
			user,               # [User]
			workstationNodeID,  # WorkstationNodeID
			nodeID,             # NodeID
			workstationID,      # WorkstationID
			regCode             # RegisterCode (same for the whole batch)
		]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(insert_sql, params, "papo_db")

	# ---- UI refresh (same convention you used) ----
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTable",   {"estado": True},  scope="session")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("closeEmbeded",   {"estado": False}, scope="session")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPeriodic",{"min": 0},        scope="session")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPreviewTable", payload=[], scope="session")
